query: We just created a new GitHub repository for our billing API and haven't pushed the first commit yet. Configure its merge settings and main branch protection ruleset.
Use the gh CLI to disable squash and rebase merges on feRpicoral/relay, enable merge commits only, and turn on automatic deletion of head branches after merge.
Write a .github/ruleset-main.json payload for gh api that protects ~DEFAULT_BRANCH with pull_request (0 required approvals), non_fast_forward, deletion, and no bypass actors.
Audit our repository's GitHub settings and branch rulesets to make sure stacked PR branches auto-delete on merge and force-pushes to main are blocked.
Our main branch ruleset currently allows repository admins to bypass PR requirements and requires 1 approval on a solo repo. Fix the ruleset JSON and gh api command.
Create a repeatable scripts/setup-github-repo.sh script that inspects the repo with gh repo view, applies our house merge settings, and creates the main branch ruleset.
Before I push main to GitHub on this new repo, what gh repo edit and gh api ruleset commands should we run to match our repository conventions?
Turn off squash merging and rebase merging on our GitHub repo so every PR merges with a merge commit and head branches are cleaned up automatically.
Replace our old curl script that hits /branches/main/protection with a gh CLI script that configures a repository branch ruleset on ~DEFAULT_BRANCH.
Check whether feRpicoral/quotahit has deleteBranchOnMerge enabled and an active main branch ruleset blocking direct pushes.
Open a pull request from feat/invoice-export to main using gh pr create with a concise summary description.
Add a GitHub Actions workflow in .github/workflows/ci.yml that runs yarn lint, yarn typecheck, and yarn test on pull requests.
Set up Husky and commitlint in this repository to enforce header-only Conventional Commits locally.
Rebase my local feature branch onto origin/main and resolve the merge conflict in src/index.ts.
Create a baseline Prisma migration in prisma/migrations/0_init/migration.sql for our Supabase database.
Configure ESLint 10 flat config in eslint.config.mjs with typescript-eslint and simple-import-sort.
Add Dependabot configuration in .github/dependabot.yml for weekly npm dependency updates.
Scaffold a new NestJS domain module for organizations with controller, service, and Prisma repository.
Use gh release create v1.2.0 to publish a new GitHub release with auto-generated release notes.
Run yarn skills-wizard skill validate skills/github-repo-setup to check the skill frontmatter against the spec.
